Norwegian FM in Dhaka to pay homage to language martyrs
2017-02-20T18:37:54+06:00 | Star Online Report
https://www.thedailystar.net/country/norwegian-fm-dhaka-pay-homage-language-martyrs-1364296

Norwegian Foreign Minister Borge Brende arrived in Dhaka this morning to pay homage to language martyrs of the great language movement at Central Shaheed Minar in the first hour of Amar Ekushey February.

He is visiting Bangladesh as the first ever foreign minister from any Nordic Country to Bangladesh.

On arrival, he was received by Kamrul Ahsan, Secretary (Bilateral & Consular) of the Foreign Ministry, Bangladesh Ambassador to Norway Md. Golam Sarwar and Director General of Europe Wing of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs were preset to receive the visiting Foreign Minister.

During the visit, the Norwegian Foreign Minister had bilateral meeting with Foreign Minister AH Mahmood Ali.

He will leave Bangladesh tomorrow.
